scope: Shared synchronous CPU int64/uint64 tensor literals, ranked checked elementwise arithmetic, scalar lifting and private native interfaces.

semantics.storage: Exact signed/unsigned eight-byte tensor cells, with shared MLIR i64 storage and distinct source type identities. Full-range literals, including signed minimum and UINT64_MAX, avoid floating conversion.
semantics.arithmetic: Reuses checked scalar helpers per lane. Signed add/sub/mul/neg use signed i128 bounds; unsigned add/mul use unsigned i128 and subtraction checks operand order. Guarded native i64 div/rem; INT64_MIN/-1 faults and INT64_MIN%-1 is zero. Unary plus preserves values.
semantics.shapes: Rank zero and fixed/dynamic shapes, matching-shape tensor pairs and same-type scalar operands in either order. No broadcasting or implicit family/width conversion. Empty tensors execute no lanes.
semantics.bounds: Static checkedNumericBytes and dynamic input/elementwise guards enforce INT64_MAX / 8. Test metadata just above this limit would pass the former four-byte guard; rejection precedes allocation and element access.
semantics.lifetime: Noncontiguous padded offset inputs, operand aliases and immutable borrowed cells. Source-located faults publish no partial result; allocation rejection and cancellation settle owners; explicit output leases remain valid after Invocation::settle.
semantics.remaining: 64-bit tensor-containing task modules are explicitly gated, including local-only tensor values in those modules. Reductions/matmul are gated in frontend and backend; Metal integer operations, further formats/conversions and public foreign-memory/wire ABI remain unqualified.

coverage: Shared signed/unsigned harness with independent signed128/unsigned128 references
22x22 signed / 18x18 unsigned boundary pairs plus 1000 deterministic full-range pairs for each arithmetic executable
Exact literals above 2^53, INT64_MIN/MAX, UINT64_MAX and unsigned values above INT64_MAX
Five binary operations in all three tensor/scalar operand arrangements; unary plus/minus
Ranks 0/1/2/3, nested and explicit-shape literals, fixed-shape refinement and dynamic shape mismatch
Padded noncontiguous views, pointer/offset displacement, aliases and input immutability
Late lane faults, negative/oversized metadata, eight-byte size limit and allocation rejection including literals
Retained output leases after invocation settlement and pre-/mid-loop cooperative cancellation
Cancellation sender startup handshake; bounded larger-workload retries only when kernel completes before observing signal
Frontend checks independently sanitized, contextual range/signedness/alias validation and forged reduction/matmul backend rejection
qualification.gpu_shader_sanitizers: Host ASan/UBSan and TSan do not instrument Metal shaders.

performance: No performance claim or benchmark in this milestone.
distributed_execution: Not implemented; agreed design discussion remains a prerequisite.
